name: X32-Edit
product: Behringer X32-Edit by Music Tribe

evidence.says: Homebrew identifies 4.4.1 as the current X32-Edit cask and links to the Behringer distribution archive.
Static inspection of X32-Edit.app/Contents/MacOS/X32-Edit with file found a universal Mach-O containing x86_64 and arm64 slices, and Info.plist gives version 4.4.1.

notes: The current bundle identifier is com.Musictribe.X32-Edit, reflecting the vendor's Music Tribe name.

name: Eos Family Welcome Screen
product: Electronic Theatre Controls (ETC) Eos Family Welcome Screen, part of ETCnomad

evidence.says: ETC's installation guide identifies Eos Family Welcome Screen as the entry point to the Eos Configuration Utility included with Eos Family offline software.
ETC identifies com.ETC.EosWelcomeScreen as the companion executable that handles ETCnomad input monitoring permissions on macOS.

limitation: No separate version was found for this component.
notes: Use the ETCnomad application as the product-level listing.

name: ontime
product: Ontime live production rundown and timer by Carlos Valente and Ontime contributors

evidence.says: The developer's release page identifies v4.15.1 as the latest stable Ontime release.
The v4.15.1 release assets include a macOS arm64 disk image alongside a macOS x64 image, dated October 28, 2026.

name: OpenEmu
product: OpenEmu by the OpenEmu Project

evidence.says: The project's version 2.4.1 notes say the Mac build is Intel-only and uses Rosetta 2 to launch on Apple silicon.
The upstream repository identifies 2.4.1 as its latest release and labels its binaries Intel-only.

limitation: Compatibility of individual emulation cores and newer macOS releases was not tested.
notes: Community Apple silicon ports are separate from the official release.

name: POD Farm 2
product: POD Farm 2 standalone guitar and bass effects application by Line 6

evidence.says: Line 6 lists POD Farm 2.59 as the Mac release and gives installation notes specific to Apple Silicon.
Line 6 says its standalone applications use Rosetta automatically and reports that POD Farm 2 Standalone worked as expected on M1 under macOS Big Sur.

limitation: The vendor test cited used macOS Big Sur.
notes: The release includes older drivers that Line 6 says to omit on Apple Silicon.

name: Active Trader Pro
product: Active Trader Pro Classic by Fidelity Investments

evidence.says: Homebrew identifies Fidelity's Active Trader Pro 1.0.55 as built for Intel macOS and requiring Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
In Fidelity's support forum, a user reports launching version 1.0.55 on an M1 Mac Studio.
Fidelity says it will begin sunsetting Active Trader Pro in 2027 as users transition to Fidelity Trader+ Desktop.

limitation: The date of the 1.0.55 release was not established.
notes: The Homebrew cask is deprecated, and Fidelity has announced a future sunset for Classic.

name: MySQLWorkbench
product: MySQL Workbench Community Edition by Oracle

evidence.says: Oracle's current general-availability download page lists MySQL Workbench 26.10.0.
The version 26.10.0 cask resolves to Oracle's macOS arm64 disk image, with the legacy scanned bundle ID recorded in its cleanup paths.
Oracle dates Workbench 26.10.0 to October 21, 2026.

notes: Oracle posted 26.10.0.1 release notes dated November 25, 2026, while its general-availability download page still listed 26.10.0 at the time checked.

name: TI-Nspire
product: TI-Nspire CX CAS Student Software by Texas Instruments

evidence.says: Texas Instruments lists the 6.3.0 CX CAS Student Software Mac build as supporting Intel and Apple silicon through Rosetta 2 on macOS 14 and 15.
Texas Instruments lists the Mac and Windows CX CAS Student Software release 6.3 with an August 21, 2025 update date.
Texas Instruments identifies 6.3.0 as the current CX CAS Student Software update.

limitation: Compatibility beyond the documented macOS releases was not tested.

name: VFX Suite Installer
product: Red Giant VFX Suite Installer by Red Giant (Maxon)

evidence.says: Maxon identifies VFX as a suite formerly delivered by its own installer and says the current unified Red Giant installer replaced it in 2024.
Maxon's VFX plug-in installation instructions direct users through the current Maxon App and Red Giant package.

notes: The scanned bundle was a legacy plug-in suite installer.

name: Trapcode Suite Installer
product: Red Giant Trapcode Suite Installer by Red Giant (Maxon)

evidence.says: Maxon identifies Trapcode as a suite formerly delivered by its own installer and says the current unified Red Giant installer replaced it in 2024.
Maxon's Trapcode Form instructions say the Red Giant package installs Trapcode plug-ins into compatible host applications.

notes: The scanned bundle was a legacy plug-in suite installer.

name: Porting Kit
product: Porting Kit by PaulTheTall and Vitor Marques de Miranda

evidence.says: The Porting Kit release repository marks 6.7.0 as the latest release.
The 6.7.0 release offers an arm64 Mac ZIP and DMG uploaded November 19, 2025.

limitation: The claim covers the Porting Kit app itself. Individual Windows games and Wine engines have separate compatibility requirements.

name: macintosh.js
product: macintosh.js System 8 emulator app by Felix Rieseberg

evidence.says: The developer's latest release includes the separate macintosh.js-darwin-arm64-1.2.0.zip Apple Silicon build.
GitHub's release metadata gives v1.2.0 a publication date of March 15, 2023 and lists the Darwin arm64 ZIP.

name: sa100-2021
product: ABC SA100 Individual Tax Return for the tax year ending April 2021 by ABC Self Assessment Ltd

evidence.says: The vendor distributes separate tax-year editions, currently lists 2023–2026, and explicitly says earlier editions are unavailable.

limitation: The architecture and final build of the 2021 tax-year edition could not be independently established.
notes: The wider ABC SA100 product remains available for later tax years.

name: AnyLogic
product: AnyLogic desktop simulation modeling environment, including Personal Learning Edition, by The AnyLogic Company

evidence.says: The current AnyLogic 8.9.10 download and model-development requirements list Apple macOS x64 and ARM.
The vendor confirms AnyLogic 8.9 added native Mac ARM operation.
The release history dates AnyLogic 8.9.10 and records Mac ARM architecture support from 8.9.0.

name: Soundly
product: Soundly desktop sound-effects library and search tool by Soundly AS

evidence.says: Soundly's official FAQ states the app runs natively on Apple ARM computers.
Inspection of Soundly.app/Contents/MacOS/Soundly in the vendor's Apple Silicon disk image found an arm64 Mach-O, and its plist identified com.soundly.Soundly version 2026.11.12.

notes: The vendor's download menu offers separate Apple Silicon and Intel images.

name: Qsync Client
product: Qsync Client for Mac by QNAP Systems

evidence.says: Inspection of Qsync Client.app/Contents/MacOS/Qsync Client in the vendor package found an x86_64-only Mach-O, and its plist identified com.qnap.qsync version 5.1.7.0923.
A user reports the 5.1.7.0923 main application running on an M1 Mac under Rosetta 2 despite an intermittent Finder integration issue.
QNAP announces its separate 6.0 Beta as a Universal Binary with native Apple Silicon support.

limitation: Rosetta operation is based on the M1 user report.
notes: The current stable main executable is Intel-only while 6.0 is still identified as beta.

name: Line 6 License Manager
product: Line 6 License Manager by Line 6

evidence.says: Line 6 announced the retirement of License Manager and the April 10, 2026 shutdown of the server for its transactions.
Line 6 lists 1.16, dated August 29, 2024, as the last Mac download.
Line 6's earlier M1 tests found that the License Manager installed but did not populate devices.

limitation: The final 1.16 executable's architecture was not established.
notes: Line 6 Central 1.04 or newer can still authorize POD Farm computer licenses.

name: HBuilderX
product: HBuilderX Alpha IDE by DCloud

evidence.says: DCloud's HBuilderX download matrix provides separate Mac Intel and Mac ARM packages for the Alpha and stable channels.
DCloud publishes the full 5.36.2026111207-alpha version in its Alpha changelog.
DCloud's download server returned HTTP 200 for the version-specific 5.36.2026111207-alpha arm64 disk image.
DCloud's Alpha announcement identifies a separate Mac ARM build and a posted crash report ties the native build to bundle ID io.dcloud.HBuilderXAlpha.
DCloud dates the 5.36.2026111207-alpha release to November 13, 2026 in its SDK release history.

notes: The scanned ID is the Alpha channel. The Homebrew hint targets stable.

name: GSAS-II
product: GSAS-II macOS launcher for the Argonne National Laboratory Advanced Photon Source crystallography suite

evidence.says: The GSAS-II developer docs describe makeMacApp as generating an AppleScript app bundle that starts the separately installed GSAS-II Python program.
The upstream installation guide provides a separate ARM64 macOS installer for the underlying GSAS-II suite.

limitation: The scanned AppleScript droplet carries a generated identifier and no application version.
notes: The underlying GSAS-II suite has an Apple Silicon distribution and can be considered separately from the scanned launcher.

name: Drobo Dashboard
product: Drobo Dashboard by Data Robotics / Drobo

evidence.says: The Drobo reseller ImageStore reports that Drobo support and products ended on January 27, 2023.
Drobo's February 2021 release notes identify Dashboard 3.6.1 build 115880 and list support for M1 Macs.
The official 3.6.1 disk image contains the main Drobo Dashboard.app/Contents/MacOS/Drobo Dashboard executable, which static inspection identified as x86_64 only.

limitation: The executable was inspected without testing device operation on recent macOS releases.
notes: The final Mac build supports M1 Macs and is Intel-only.

name: MuseScore
product: MuseScore Studio by MuseScore (Muse Group)

evidence.says: MuseScore announces version 4.7.7 as a stable update.
The 4.7.7 source tag defines a universal macOS build job for stable releases.
The tagged release ships the resulting macOS disk image as MuseScore-Studio-4.7.7.261109195.dmg on November 12, 2026.

notes: MuseScore 4 is now branded MuseScore Studio.

name: REEF-Survey
product: REEF Survey Data Entry Application by Reef Environmental Education Foundation

evidence.says: REEF lists macOS 1.1205.1003 as its current application installer and dates it December 18, 2021.
Static inspection of REEF-Survey.app/Contents/MacOS/REEF-Survey in the official package found only x86_64, and Info.plist confirms version 1.1205.1003 and org.reef.offline-survey-entry.
REEF's 1.1205 release notes describe compatibility through macOS Monterey without identifying tested hardware.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation on Apple Silicon was not established.
notes: REEF still updates the survey data files separately from the 2021 app.

name: ClickRepair
product: ClickRepair standalone audio restoration by Brian Davies

evidence.says: Brian Davies's archived version 3.9 manual identifies the standalone ClickRepair audio restoration application and its Java implementation.
The former official domain currently displays a password-protected storefront with no public ClickRepair download.
The January 2026 user discussion reports that the new owner closed the revived ClickRepair distribution site.
The application catalog marks ClickRepair discontinued and no longer offers a download.

limitation: The final official Mac release and its launcher architecture could not be established.
notes: This is the offline Java desktop app. ClickRepairRT and SweetVinyl hardware are separate products.

name: APG Live Manager
product: APG Live Manager loudspeaker processor control software by APG France (Arbane Groupe)

evidence.says: APG continues to list the installer for macOS version 1.8.10.
APG's November 2023 presets guide states that APG Live Manager ends at version 1.8.10 and will receive no further updates.

Static inspection of the official package found that APG Live Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/APG Live Manager is x86_64 only, with version 1.8.10 and the matching bundle identifier confirmed by Info.plist.

limitation: The last release is Intel-only and Rosetta operation was not verified.
notes: APG still distributes the final installer for legacy hardware.

name: Plugable Digital Viewer
product: Plugable Digital Viewer for the Plugable USB microscope, using Sunpet's viewer

evidence.says: Plugable lists Digital Viewer 3.3.30 as the current download for macOS 10.13 and later.
Static inspection of Plugable Digital Viewer.app/Contents/MacOS/Plugable Digital Viewer in the 3.3.30 installer found an x86_64-only Mach-O with bundle ID com.sunpet.xploviewmac.
The microCAM developer reports running Intel-only Plugable Digital Viewer for extended periods on an Apple Silicon Mac.
A separate first-hand inspection on an M4 Mac confirms that the current Plugable 3.3.30 build needs Rosetta for launch.

limitation: Apple Silicon runtime evidence comes from user reports.
notes: The vendor's 3.3.30 download carries CFBundleShortVersionString 5 and CFBundleVersion 1.0, explaining version 5 in the scan.

name: MODO BASS
product: Original MODO BASS 1.x standalone instrument by IK Multimedia

evidence.says: IK Multimedia's representative calls the original MODO BASS discontinued in post 31 of the MODO BASS 2 announcement.
IK Multimedia Japan lists original MODO BASS 1.5.2 under Rosetta 2 compatibility for the application and plug-in releases.
Rosetta Check identifies the original 1.5.2 standalone bundle as Intel-only.
IK sells the native Apple Silicon MODO BASS 2 as an upgrade.

limitation: No later original 1.x build was independently verified.
notes: The documented original 1.5.2 build was Intel-only with Rosetta 2 support. The old product URL redirects to MODO BASS 2.

name: Audio Converter Pro
product: Audio Converter Pro by Geranium Software (Mac App Store seller Fatima Malagouen)

evidence.says: Apple lists Geranium Software's Mac app and identifies 2.2.5, dated September 30, 2018, as the latest version.
Rosetta Check's scan database reports that the exact com.geranium-soft.audioconverter bundle at version 2.2.5 is Intel-only.

limitation: The architecture is based on third-party install scans, and launch under Rosetta 2 was not verified.

name: Battery Amperage
product: Battery Amperage for Mac by Haitham Khedre

evidence.says: The historical Mac App Store directory identifies a Battery Amperage utility by Haitham Khedre.
Apple's lookup returns zero current Mac App Store records for the scanned bundle identifier.

limitation: No current vendor release or architecture evidence for the scanned bundle could be found.
notes: The scan reports 4.3 and the accessible historical directory snapshot shows 4.0.

name: Companion
product: Bitfocus Companion by Bitfocus AS

evidence.says: Bitfocus's stable release API publishes the separate mac-arm build of Companion v5.1.3 with an arm64 disk image and a November 12, 2026 publication date.
Fleet identifies the same Companion product and associates the older test-companion.bitfocus.no identifier with the current companion.bitfocus.no bundle.

notes: The listing's test-companion.bitfocus.no bundle ID is a legacy Companion identifier.

name: Mural
product: Mural collaboration desktop app by Tactivos, Inc. d/b/a Mural

evidence.says: Mural lists its macOS desktop app separately from the iOS app and links to the 3.0.4 installer.
Mural's update feed names 3.0.4, gives its March 7, 2025 release date and lists its 174 MB zip and 180 MB disk image without architecture metadata.
Homebrew independently lists Mural desktop version 3.0.4.

limitation: No first-party architecture statement was found, and both current official packages exceed the brief's binary inspection size limit.

name: EnscapeApplication
product: EnscapeApplication rendering bundle installed with Enscape for Mac by Chaos

evidence.says: An Enscape support thread identifies EnscapeApplication.app in the context of installing and troubleshooting the SketchUp extension.
Chaos documents launching Enscape from within the host CAD or BIM application's toolbar.
Chaos announced native Apple Silicon operation for the Enscape for Mac product in Service Pack 2.1.0.

limitation: The architecture of the old EnscapeApplication bundle was not independently verified.
notes: The scanned bundle belonged to a host-dependent rendering product. If the site covers plug-ins, Enscape for Mac as a product is a distinct listing decision.

product: 115 desktop cloud-storage client (115桌面版 / 115生活) by Guangdong 115 Technology

evidence.says: The historical desktop cask ties the scanned org.115pc.115Desktop ID to the cloud-storage client installed as 115生活.app.
115 Technology announces 115生活 macOS 37.3.3 and supplies separate native Intel and Apple Silicon downloads.
Static inspection found arm64 in 115生活.app/Contents/MacOS/115生活 and read version 37.3.3 with identifier com.115.life.mac from its Info.plist.
The name-matched Homebrew hint describes the distinct 115Browser product.

notes: The current cloud-storage client uses bundle ID com.115.life.mac. The 2.x download associated with the scanned bundle ID returned 404.

name: Anghami
product: Anghami Desktop music-streaming app by Anghami

evidence.says: The device page lists Anghami's desktop app alongside the web player.
Anghami documents a standalone Mac desktop app and gives a minimum OS without naming a release or CPU architecture.
Anghami's Mac troubleshooting article confirms the downloadable desktop product but supplies no version or architecture.

limitation: The current desktop macOS version and architecture were not verified from the available installation and support pages.
notes: The source scan is for version 2.4.0.

name: Sliver
product: Sliver by Apple Tech 752

evidence.says: The listing's historical bundle metadata identifies Apple Tech 752's Sliver and the scanned 6.2 release.

limitation: The current architecture for this exact macOS bundle was not verified.

name: LAMA
product: LAMA (Little Audio Measurement Application) by Sononum

evidence.says: Sononum names LAMA as its macOS audio measurement product.
The developer's update feed lists 1.5 build 1500 as its newest release, dated March 21, 2017.
Static inspection of the official ZIP found that LAMA.app/Contents/MacOS/LAMA is x86_64 only, with the matching net.lama-audio.LAMA bundle identifier and 1.5 version in Info.plist.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation was not established.
notes: The dedicated lama-audio.net product site was unavailable, while Sononum's official feed and ZIP still worked.

name: GaussView
product: GaussView molecular visualization and input editor by Gaussian, Inc. and Semichem, Inc.

evidence.says: Gaussian's Mac installation guide identifies the GaussView 6 installer series by the MacOSX_x86_64 archive name.
The distributor currently offers GaussViewM 6.1.1 for macOS.
Kyoto University's licensing catalog explicitly labels the GaussView 6.1.1 Mac distribution Intel 64-bit and lists a separate ARM release of the Gaussian calculation engine.

limitation: Version-specific confirmation comes from an institutional license listing, and no reliable Rosetta 2 runtime evidence was found for GaussView 6.1.1.
notes: GaussView is a separate GUI from the Gaussian 16 calculation engine.

name: UniFi Network Server
product: Legacy UniFi Network Server (UniFi Network Application) by Ubiquiti

evidence.says: Ubiquiti lists the legacy standalone macOS download at 10.6.109 dated October 23, 2026.
Ubiquiti's legacy macOS setup guide says to install Rosetta if prompted and leaves the current launcher architecture unspecified.
The disabled Homebrew cask explicitly identifies its older 10.6.101 build as Intel-only and requiring Rosetta 2.
Ubiquiti documents that the separate UniFi OS Server supersedes the legacy Network Server and supports migrating an existing installation.

limitation: The current 10.6.109 DMG exceeds 150 MB, and the exact architecture of its UniFi.app launcher was not established.
notes: The UniFi OS Server Apple Silicon download is for the successor product. Ubiquiti has a newer 10.6.111 release candidate for the legacy standalone build.

name: LogiTune
product: Logi Tune Desktop by Logitech

evidence.says: Logitech's June 2023 notes explicitly say version 3.2.247 introduced native Apple Silicon support.
Logitech lists Tune Desktop 3.15.96 dated October 30, 2026 as a bug-fix release.
Softpedia's Mac software catalog lists Logi Tune 3.15.96 as a Universal Binary.
Iru's deployment catalog identifies Logitech's 3.15.96 as the current Logi Tune release for Mac.

limitation: The current installer exceeds 150 MB, so its executable was not independently inspected.

name: OKX
product: OKX exchange desktop trading app by OKX, formerly OKEx

evidence.says: The vendor lists a downloadable macOS desktop trading app alongside its mobile product.
The vendor's desktop installation instructions identify the Mac client but give no build number or architecture.
The vendor's regional desktop instructions list standard and older-macOS compatibility DMGs without architecture labels.

limitation: The current standard Mac package version and architecture could not be verified, and that disk image exceeded the 150 MB inspection limit.

name: GTX Graphics Lab 6
product: GTX Graphics Lab 6 garment-print layout software by Brother International

evidence.says: Brother's GTX owner portal lists the Mac GTX Graphics Lab 6.2 download as updated August 29, 2023.
Static inspection of Brother's 6.2.0 package matched com.brother.graphihslab and found only x86_64 in GTX Graphics Lab 6.app/Contents/MacOS/GTX Graphics Lab 6.
Brother documents Apple Silicon compatibility for its newer GTX Graphics Lab 9.0 workflow.

limitation: Rosetta operation of the exact 6.2.0 app and the architecture of the newer 9.0 package were not established.
notes: This disposition applies to the downloadable GTX Graphics Lab 6 bundle. A Brother garment-printer driver is also required for normal operation.
